decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp, multi-axis transient near index 485–495 with strong coupling across N/E/U and no immediate return; (2) a prolonged U plateau (~605–625) amid steady N/E drift, hinting at possible offset or platform behavior. Other segments show noisy but smooth motion or missing data.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample rise in U (from ~10.3 to ~11.1) coinciding with a large E jump (~-0.5 to +0.3), followed by abrupt drop in U and E over next few samples; N also jumps sharply. Cross-axis shape shows coupled N/E/U excursion without clear return within window.

Extended plateau-like behavior in U (~9–10) from index ~605–625, while N and E show sustained drift: N rises steadily (~21→24), E drops (~-9→-11). The U platform appears decoupled from the monotonic N/E trend, suggesting possible superposed offset or sensor artifact.
